```{r}
#| label: setup

# パッケージの読み込み -----

## 量的テキスト分析 -----
library(quanteda)

## 名前衝突対応 -----
library(conflicted)

# ggplotのデフォルトテーマ（全プロットに適用） ----
ggplot2::theme_set(
  theme_classic() +
     theme_sub_legend(position   = "bottom") +
    theme_sub_axis_bottom(
      title = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      text  = element_text(size = 8.5)
    ) +
    theme_sub_axis_left(
      title = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(r = 8)),
      text  = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0)
    ) +
    theme_sub_legend(
      position   = "bottom",
      margin     = margin(t = -4),
      key.size   = unit(3.5, "mm")
    ) +
    theme_sub_plot(
      title   = element_text(size = 11),
      caption = element_text(size = 9)
    )
)

# 日本語フォント ----
font_add(
  "jp",
  "/System/Library/Fonts/ヒラギノ角ゴシック W3.ttc"
)

showtext_auto()

# 優先する関数を指定 ----
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(purrr::map)
conflicts_prefer(purrr::compact())
conflicts_prefer(quanteda::dictionary)

# ---- 設定 ----
src_var <- "source_1"
pos_var <- "stance_on_army"

# ---- データの読み込み ----
obj <- readRDS("prep/prep_standingarmy.rds")

df_army  <- obj$df
corp     <- obj$corp
dfm_raw  <- obj$dfm_raw
dfm_stem <- obj$dfm_stem
tok_base <- obj$tok_base
tok_pad  <- obj$tok_pad

# ---- 辞書の読み込み ----
dict_pol <- dictionary(file = "dictionaries/political_vocabulary.yml")
dict_rhe <- dictionary(file = "dictionaries/rhetoric.yml")
dicts    <- list(political = dict_pol, rhetoric = dict_rhe)

# ---- 関数 ----
group_key <- function(x, by = c(src_var, pos_var)) {
  dv   <- docvars(x)
  miss <- setdiff(by, names(dv))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop("docvars に列がありません: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         "\n利用できる列: ", paste(names(dv), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  do.call(paste, c(as.list(dv[by]), sep = "_"))
}

split_by_group <- function(x, subset_fn, by = c(src_var, pos_var)) {
  grp <- group_key(x, by)
  map(set_names(unique(grp)), \(g) subset_fn(x, subset = grp == g))
}

run_keyness <- function(dfm_x, var, target, reference = NULL,
                        min_termfreq = 10, measure = "lr") {
  g <- docvars(dfm_x, var)
  if (!is.null(reference)) {
    dfm_x <- dfm_x[g %in% c(target, reference), ]
    g <- docvars(dfm_x, var)
  }
  dfm_x <- dfm_trim(dfm_x, min_termfreq = min_termfreq)
  textstat_keyness(dfm_x, target = g == target, measure = measure) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
}

# ---- グループ別オブジェクト（keyness・KWIC 用）----
dfm_by  <- split_by_group(dfm_raw,  dfm_subset)
tok_by  <- split_by_group(tok_base, tokens_subset)
corp_by <- split_by_group(corp,     corpus_subset)

# ---- 辞書用 tokens（ストップワードを除去しない）----
tok_dict <- tok_base |>
  tokens_compound(
    phrase(c("for this reason", "for the reason", "for these reasons", "for which reason",
             "time of peace", "times of peace")),
    concatenator = "_"
  )

# 仮名版の判定
n_pseudo <- tokens_select(tok_dict, c("lilliput*", "blefuscu*", "senate*")) |> ntoken()
docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym") <- n_pseudo > 0

dfm_all <- dfm(tok_dict)

# ---- 文書 × カテゴリの表 ----
n_tok <- tibble(
  doc_id    = docnames(tok_dict),
  n_tokens  = as.numeric(ntoken(tok_dict)),
  source    = as.character(docvars(tok_dict, src_var)),
  stance    = docvars(tok_dict, pos_var),
  pseudonym = docvars(tok_dict, "pseudonym")
)

df_long <- imap_dfr(dicts, \(d, nm) {
  convert(dfm(tokens_lookup(tok_dict, d)), to = "data.frame") |>
    as_tibble() |>
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "category", values_to = "count") |>
    mutate(dictionary = nm)
}) |>
  left_join(n_tok, by = "doc_id") |>
  mutate(per_1000 = if_else(n_tokens > 0, count / n_tokens * 1000, NA_real_))

dfm_all <- dfm(tok_dict)

stopifnot(
  identical(docnames(dfm_all), docnames(tok_dict)),
  identical(docnames(corp),    docnames(tok_dict))
)

meta_spk <- tibble(
  doc_id  = docnames(tok_dict),
  speaker = docvars(tok_dict, "speaker_disguised_name")
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(meta_spk$speaker))

df_spk <- df_long |>
  filter(stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army")) |>
  left_join(meta_spk, by = "doc_id") |>
  group_by(dictionary, category, source, stance, speaker) |>
  summarise(n_speeches = n(), n_tokens = sum(n_tokens), count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(per_1000 = count / n_tokens * 1000)

```


# count

## token

```{r}

tok_count <- function(x, name) {
  tibble(doc_id = docnames(x), !!name := as.numeric(ntoken(x)))
}

meta <- tibble(
  doc_id = docnames(tok_dict),
  source = as.character(docvars(tok_dict, src_var)),
  stance = docvars(tok_dict, pos_var)
)

tab_tok <- tok_count(tok_base, "tok_base") |>
  left_join(tok_count(tok_dict, "tok_dict"), by = "doc_id") |>
  left_join(tok_count(dfm_raw, "dfm_raw"), by = "doc_id") |>
  left_join(meta, by = "doc_id")

tab_tok |>
  group_by(source, stance) |>
  summarise(
    n_speeches = n(),
    across(c(tok_base, tok_dict, dfm_raw), sum),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(source, stance)

```

# dictionary

## plot


```{r}

plot_dict <- function(dict_name, ncol = 4, drop = character(),
                      title = NULL, fig_no = NULL) {
  lv <- c("gm pro", "gm anti", "lm pro", "lm anti")

  d <- df_long |>
    filter(dictionary == dict_name,
           stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army"),
           !category %in% drop) |>
    mutate(
      group    = factor(paste(source, if_else(stance == "pro_army", "pro", "anti")), levels = lv),
      category = fct_reorder(category, per_1000, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)
    )

  ttl <- if (is.null(title)) NULL else
    str_wrap(paste0(if (!is.null(fig_no)) paste0("Fig.", fig_no, ". "), title), width = 90)

  ggplot(d, aes(group,
                per_1000,
                colour = stance)
         ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5,
               linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "grey60") +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12,
                height = 0,
                alpha = 0.7,
                size = 1.8) +
    stat_summary(fun = median,
                 geom = "point",
                 shape = 18,
                 size = 3.5,
                 colour = "#009900FF",
                 alpha = 0.8,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ category,
               scales = "free_y",
               ncol = ncol,
               labeller = label_wrap_gen(22)
               ) +
    scale_colour_paletteer_d("nbapalettes::sixers_retro") + 
    labs(
      title  = ttl,
      x      = NULL,
      y      = "normalized frequency (per 1,000 words)",
      colour = NULL,
      caption = "Green diamonds indicate the median of each group."
    ) 
}

p_pol <- plot_dict("political",
                   ncol = 3,
                   fig_no = 3,
                   title =
                     "Political Vocabulary in GM and LM Speeches for and against Standing Armies")

p_rhe <- plot_dict("rhetoric",
                   ncol = 4,
                   fig_no = 4,
                   title = "Rhetorical Vocabulary in GM and LM Speeches for and against Standing Armies")

p_pol
p_rhe
```

## share

```{r}

grp_lab <- c("gm pro_army"     = "GM\nPro-army",
             "gm anti_army" = "GM\nAnti-army",
             "lm pro_army"     = "LM\nPro-army",
             "lm anti_army" = "LM\nAnti-army")

cat_levels <- c("foreign_affairs", "crown_ministry_party", "parliament_and_procedure",
                "constitution_and_law", "people_and_public_good",
                "finance_and_commerce", "threats_to_liberty")

share_tbl <- df_long |>
  filter(dictionary == "political", stance %in% c("pro_army", "anti_army")) |>
  group_by(source, stance, category) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(source, stance) |>
  mutate(share = count / sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    grp      = factor(paste(source, stance), levels = names(grp_lab), labels = unname(grp_lab)),
    category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels)
  )

p_share <- ggplot(share_tbl, aes(share, fct_rev(grp), fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(share >= 0.08, percent(share, accuracy = 1), ""),
        group = category),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
    size = 7, colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("MetBrewer::Austria") + 
  labs(x = "Share of dictionary hits",
       y = NULL,
       fill = NULL,
      title = "Fig.2. Relative Frequency of Political Vocabulary in GM and LM Speeches on Standing Armies")

p_share
```

# keyness

## plot

```{r}

key_gm <- dfm_raw |> dfm_subset(source_1 == "gm") |> run_keyness(pos_var, "pro_army", "anti_army")
key_lm <- dfm_raw |> dfm_subset(source_1 == "lm") |> run_keyness(pos_var, "pro_army", "anti_army")

make_key_plot <- function(key, label, fig_no, n = 15) {
  d <- key |>
    mutate(
      group = if_else(G2 > 0, "pro_army", "anti_army"),
      sig = case_when(
        p_adj < 0.05 ~ "Adjusted p < .05",
        p     < 0.05 ~ "Unadjusted p < .05 only",
        TRUE         ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      sig = factor(sig, levels = c("Adjusted p < .05", "Unadjusted p < .05 only", "Not significant"))
    ) |>
    group_by(group) |>
    slice_max(abs(G2), n = n, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      score = abs(G2),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("pro_army", "anti_army"),
                     labels = c("Defending Standing Armies", "Opposing Standing Armies"))
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(score, reorder_within(feature, score, group), fill = sig)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_reordered() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Adjusted p < .05"        = "grey20",
                                 "Unadjusted p < .05 only" = "grey60",
                                 "Not significant"         = "grey90"),
                      drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Fig.", fig_no, ". Terms Ranked by Keyness in ", label,
                     " Speeches for and against Standing Armies"),
      x = "Log-likelihood ratio (G2)", y = NULL, fill = NULL
    ) 
}

p_gm <- make_key_plot(key_gm, "GM", 3)
p_lm <- make_key_plot(key_lm, "LM", 4)

p_gm
p_lm
```
